description:
FR-M44-06/07, NFR-40, MVP-R6.1 (MV1-T09): every external contract Meridian derives evidence from, pinned to the version the code was built against.

What this catches: a version the code declares drifting away from the version reviewed here, in either direction. A pin changed without the mapping being re-read, or a mapping updated without the pin moving, both fail.

What this DOES NOT catch, stated plainly because a check whose limits are unwritten gets trusted past them: a rename upstream that nobody has noticed yet. Detecting that needs the upstream schema, which means a network call, and a gate that depends on a third party being reachable fails for reasons that have nothing to do with the code. The honest division is that this file makes drift a REVIEWED event rather than a silent one — when a vendor ships a breaking change, updating the pin is what forces someone to look at the mapping.

When a contract is unpinned or unknown, coverage degrades visibly (NFR-40) rather than the evidence being mapped on a guess.

contracts.name: OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions
contracts.risk: The conventions remain at Development status with documented rename risk. Attribute names Meridian reads may change without a major version.

contracts.name: Agent Client Protocol
contracts.risk: Single-integer protocol versioning: a bump is not required to be backward compatible, and agent identity is optional in the specification.

contracts.name: Git commit trailers (Co-Authored-By, Meridian-Ledger)
contracts.risk: A convention rather than a specification. Unauthenticated by construction — see D55.
